name: Groovebox 12 Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Kits for Groovebox 12 in the most common styles: techno, house, trance, drum & bass, dubstep, hip-hop, funk & disco, electro, pop, rock, jazz and synthwave. Each kit sets the tempo, the drum sounds, a one-bar groove and a bass line, with pads and leads where the style calls for them. Drum and bass folders at 174 BPM: Tech Step, Liquid DnB, Dancefloor DnB, Neurofunk, Jump Up, Jungle and Halftime DnB. Each kit chains several one-bar patterns (groove, variation, fill) and carries a bass line.
